context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp Business Desk MVP is fully functional. All features tested: login, 3-column inbox layout, conversation list with filters, chat view with messages, detail panel with Info/Notes/History tabs, status changes, agent assignment, internal notes, audit trail, dashboard KPIs, agents management, logout. Backend uses Supabase PostgreSQL for auth and data. Frontend uses React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui. All 22 backend API tests pass. All frontend features verified via Playwright.
